Stage 0: the gripper came to the mug (100-124; it fills the wrist view) and the fingers closed at ~127-144 at the mug's front wall without touching it (no contact in the packet; the wall appears just at/beyond the fingertips). The fingers then stayed closed (0.001) for the rest of the episode. From ~160 the arm backed off and from 248 to 1200 it hovered 15-30 cm in front of the mug inside the cabinet opening, the mug centred in the wrist view, without another grasp. The mug never moved; the machine was never approached.
causal_chain: close at the mug wall without contact (127) -> gripper never reopens -> ~1050 steps hovering in front of the mug with closed fingers -> mug never picked -> timeout
